rooms.1: The dusty main street of an abandoned Old West ghost town at dusk: a weathered false-front barbershop with a striped pole on the left and a stone jailhouse with barred windows on the right, their signboards blank, a dirt road running into the distance toward purple mountains, a tumbleweed, an orange sunset sky.
rooms.2: The dusty main street of an abandoned Old West ghost town at dusk: a saloon with swinging doors and a balcony on the left and a dry-goods store with a porch on the right, blank signboards, a dirt road toward purple mountains, an orange sunset.
rooms.3: The main street of an abandoned Old West ghost town at dusk: a small telegraph office with a telegraph pole and sagging wires on the left, a two-storey hotel with a balcony on the right, blank signboards, a dirt road, purple mountains, an orange sunset.
rooms.4: The west end of an abandoned Old West ghost town at dusk: a big red wooden stable with a hayloft door on the right, a cactus, the dirt road running out of town toward purple mountains, an orange sunset.
rooms.5: Inside an old red wooden stable: plank walls, bales of hay stacked on the left, a hayloft above, a horseshoe on a nail, a dirt floor; the middle and right of the floor are clear.
rooms.6: A lonely dirt road through the desert outside a ghost town: saguaro cactus, rocky buttes, snow-tipped purple mountains, a blazing sun in a blue sky.
rooms.7: A fork in a dirt desert road: a weathered wooden signpost with blank arrows, cactus, mesas and purple mountains, a blue sky.
rooms.8: Standing on a ridge above a narrow ravine: the steep dark ravine dropping away in the middle, mountains in the distance, a blue sky with purple peaks.
rooms.9: A large field of green grass with a split-rail wooden fence across it, purple mountains beyond, a bright sun in a blue sky.
rooms.10: Down in a dry rocky ravine: steep earth and rock walls rising on either side, blue sky above, sagebrush, a dusty floor; the middle of the far rock wall is bare.
rooms.11: Inside a dusty abandoned Old West saloon: a long wooden bar on the left with bottles on shelves, a hanging oil lamp, round tables and chairs, plank walls; the middle of the back wall is bare.
rooms.12: A hidden back office behind a saloon: a desk with an oil lamp, a faded map pinned to the wall, plank walls and dust.
rooms.13: An Old West sheriff's office: a desk, a gun rack, a wanted poster with no writing, plank walls and floor; the middle of the back wall is bare.
rooms.14: Inside a jail cell: rough stone block walls, a small barred window high up, a cot, iron bars along the front.
rooms.15: Inside an abandoned Old West dry-goods store: shelves of dusty colourful tins, jars and bolts of cloth behind a long wooden counter, an oil lamp.
rooms.16: Inside an Old West barbershop: a red barber's chair before a large mirror, a striped barber pole by the wall, shaving mugs on a shelf, plank floor.
rooms.17: A dirt road outside a ghost town at sunset: a low hill with three wooden grave crosses on the right, a cactus, the road leading away, an orange sky.
rooms.18: Standing on a ridge above a deep ravine: the ravine falling away below, purple mountains and an orange sunset beyond.
rooms.19: A horse stall inside a red wooden stable: plank walls, a feed trough, hay on the floor, a horseshoe; the middle of the stall is empty.
rooms.20: Boot Hill graveyard at sunset: rows of leaning wooden grave crosses and a few headstones on a dusty hill, a dead tree, an orange sky; the ground in the left middle is bare.
rooms.21: Inside an old silver mine near the entrance: timber supports and beams, daylight from an opening above, a wooden ladder, rocky walls, a dark tunnel ahead.
rooms.22: Deep in an old silver mine: timber-shored tunnel, a wooden ladder going up on the left, mine-cart rails on the floor, darkness ahead.
rooms.23: The dead end of an old silver mine tunnel: timber supports, a rock face streaked with a glinting vein of silver.
rooms.24: Inside a small Old West telegraph office: a counter with a brass telegraph key, a window, wires along the ceiling, plank walls; the right side of the room is bare.
rooms.25: Riding a pinto horse: looking forward between the horse's ears over its brown-and-white mane, inside a red wooden stable.
rooms.26: Lying in a warm hotel bed at night: a red checkered quilt, a feather pillow, a moonlit window above.
rooms.27: An Old West hotel room: red wallpaper, a washstand with a pitcher and basin, a window, a plank floor; the middle of the room is bare.
rooms.28: An Old West hotel lobby: red wallpaper, a staircase on the right, a hanging lamp, a mail cubby on the back wall; the middle of the floor is clear.
rooms.29: Down in a freshly dug grave: walls of dark earth all around, a broken coffin, roots, the evening sky above.
rooms.30: Flat on my back in a stable's manure pile, looking up at the hayloft beams and a red barn roof, straw everywhere.
rooms.31: An Old West storeroom: plank walls, shelves of crates and boxes, a dusty floor; the middle of the floor is clear.
rooms.32: A narrow mountain trail climbing between rocky slopes, pine trees, purple mountains and a sunset sky; a level clearing on the right.
rooms.33: Inside a lonely line shack: rough log walls, a small table with a telegraph key, a stove, a small window.
rooms.34: A root cellar: earthen walls, shelves of dusty jars, a ladder up to a trapdoor, a pile of animal pelts in the corner.
rooms.35: Behind the counter of an Old West hotel: the polished wooden counter in the foreground, a wall of room-key pigeonholes, a small bell, a blank sign (no writing).
rooms.36: A hidden canyon: towering red rock walls, a slice of blue sky, a small campfire, a sandy floor; the right side of the floor is open.
rooms.37: Inside a Native American teepee: hide walls with painted bands rising to the smoke hole, a fire in the centre, blankets on the floor.
rooms.38: Death: an Old West gallows with a noose silhouetted against a blood-orange sunset.
